contract.domain: Proposed single channel He4+ (ground 1s 2S) + electron -> neutral He4 ground 1s2 1S + spontaneous photon; conditional He4 assignment, stationary heavy target and zero recoil in the saved bath frame. Reuse saved T=10000K chains, theta=0.8617333262145178eV, q=chi*theta for chi=1.5 or3, reflecting U=40*theta or80*theta, and E in the actual saved active grid q<E<=U. Native C23B HeI fitted threshold24.59eV must match the selected provider identity; epsilon=E+I must lie inside that provider verified finite support. No other He4 charge branch, isotope, bath T, energy outside support, stimulated RR or all-level total RR is covered.
